authority: CTO Round 200 directive: pre-register the R199-C3 killer experiment per EXPERIMENT_VALIDITY_GATE_V1 (Article XXXVI). Execution is Round 201+.
constitutional_basis: Article VII — never weaken the verifier to rescue a claim
Article XIX — never optimize for the gate (frozen parameters are the validity check)
Article XXVII — no threshold invention (thresholds need provenance)
Article XXVIII — no silent semantic promotion
Article XXIX — separate implementation failure from mechanism failure
Article XXXVI — Experiment Validity Gate (7 conditions)
Article XXXVII — Future-Novelty Test (ratified this round)

the_experiment.name: R199-C3 Irreversibility Boundary Discrimination Test
the_experiment.the_killer_question: Can the candidate distinguish patients with identical observable trajectories but different distances from irreversibility?
the_experiment.the_falsifier: If the candidate cannot distinguish them (AUROC < 0.55), the candidate is KILLED. The recoverability framing adds no discriminating information beyond the observables.
the_experiment.the_baseline_failure_mode: The risk predictor baseline should output SIMILAR risk for both patients in a pair (because observables are identical). This is the baseline's predicted failure — it cannot see the hidden irreversibility distance.

the_candidate_algorithm.name: Patient-Specific Irreversibility Boundary Estimator
the_candidate_algorithm.architecture: Structural Causal Model (per Springer 2026) + Bayesian time-to-irreversibility estimator + bootstrap uncertainty quantification
the_candidate_algorithm.training: Patient-specific causal model fit on 30-day longitudinal history. Bootstrap N=1000 for uncertainty.
the_candidate_algorithm.inference: Real-time update every 1 hour. Boundary estimation via posterior predictive.

the_baseline_algorithm.name: Risk Predictor (US 20260115436-style)
the_baseline_algorithm.architecture: Gradient boosted trees predicting P(shunt failure within 7 days)
the_baseline_algorithm.inputs: SAME as candidate — no information advantage
the_baseline_algorithm.training: Trained on same 30-day history. Calibrated against published smart shunt AI performance.
the_baseline_algorithm.calibration_target: AUROC 0.75-0.85 (per published smart shunt AI literature)

2_IMPLEMENTATION_MATCHES_PROTOCOL.the_implementation_rule: The candidate algorithm must implement EXACTLY the SCM + Bayesian estimator + bootstrap. No substitution. Code review required before execution.

3_BASELINE_FAIR.baseline_source: US 20260115436 (April 2026 smart shunt AI) + published smart shunt prediction literature
3_BASELINE_FAIR.baseline_reproduction_fidelity: Must achieve AUROC 0.75-0.85 on a published benchmark (else baseline is INVALID)
3_BASELINE_FAIR.no_silent_weakening: Baseline must NOT be given reduced sampling frequency, poorer parameters, or fewer sensors. Same data stream.
3_BASELINE_FAIR.the_asymmetry_documentation: The candidate's asymmetry is the RECOVERABILITY FRAMING. This is the invention being tested. The baseline does NOT have this framing. By design.

4_NO_DATA_LEAKAGE.train_test_split: 60/40, stratified by distance-to-irreversibility (ground truth in simulation)
4_NO_DATA_LEAKAGE.the_ground_truth: In simulation, the distance-to-irreversibility is KNOWN (set by the simulator). The candidate does NOT have access to the ground truth — only to the observables.

WIN_threshold.metric: AUROC for distinguishing irreversibility distance in patient pairs
WIN_threshold.provenance: MODEL_DERIVED — 0.75 is the standard 'useful discrimination' threshold in clinical prediction (Hosmer & Lemeshow)
WIN_threshold.baseline_must_FAIL: baseline AUROC < 0.60 (near random, because observables are identical within pairs)

KILL_threshold.metric: AUROC for distinguishing irreversibility distance in patient pairs
KILL_threshold.provenance: MODEL_DERIVED — 0.55 is near random (0.50 = random). Below this, the candidate adds no discriminating information.

MMD_threshold.metric: Maximum Mean Discrepancy between candidate predictions and ground truth
MMD_threshold.provenance: ENGINEERING — standard MMD threshold for distributional match

candidate_hyperparameters.scm_structure: pre-specified (ICP -> flow -> boundary; biomarkers -> boundary; posture -> ICP)
candidate_hyperparameters.bayesian_prior: weakly informative Normal(0, 1) for boundary coefficients

6_MODEL_SPECIFICATION_FROZEN.no_post_hoc_tuning: If sensitivity analysis is performed, it must use PRE-REGISTERED ranges.

7_RANDOM_SEED_COHORT_PROVENANCE_COMPLETE.patient_pair_structure: 100 pairs, each pair has identical observables (within noise) but different irreversibility distances (ground truth delta >= 12 hours)

the_four_epistemic_states_overlay.VALIDATED_POSITIVE: All 7 conditions pass AND candidate AUROC >= 0.75 AND baseline AUROC < 0.60. Candidate advances to Level 4 (WORLD_CLASS_REVIEW).
the_four_epistemic_states_overlay.VALIDATED_NEGATIVE: All 7 conditions pass AND candidate AUROC < 0.55. Candidate is KILLED. Cemetery entry.
the_four_epistemic_states_overlay.EXPERIMENT_INVALID: Any of 7 conditions fail. Candidate state UNCHANGED.
the_four_epistemic_states_overlay.INFRASTRUCTURE_BLOCKED: Simulation environment cannot execute. Candidate state UNCHANGED.

the_killer_experiment_rationale.why_this_experiment_is_discriminating: Directly tests the candidate's core claim: that 'recoverability' is a distinct decision variable from 'risk.' If the candidate can distinguish patients with identical observables but different irreversibility distances, it has access to information the risk predictor lacks.
the_killer_experiment_rationale.the_asymmetry_test: The asymmetry is the RECOVERABILITY FRAMING. The experiment tests whether this framing adds discriminating power.

honest_disclosure.what_this_pre_registration_does: Specifies all 7 validity conditions before execution. Prevents 'tuning during debugging' failure mode.
honest_disclosure.what_this_pre_registration_does_NOT_do: Does not guarantee the experiment is CORRECT. A valid experiment can still produce wrong results due to model misspecification or simulator bias.
honest_disclosure.the_simulator_risk: The synthetic cohort is generated by a simulator. If the simulator's irreversibility model is wrong, the experiment tests the simulator, not the candidate. Mitigation: simulator based on published physiological models (critical transition theory, treatment futility literature).
honest_disclosure.execution_status: PRE-REGISTERED, NOT EXECUTED. Execution is Round 201.
